metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1940 · Fantasia
metas.description: A series of eight famous pieces of classical music, conducted by Leopold Stokowski and interpreted in animation by Walt Disney's team of artists.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1937 · Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
metas.description: Exiled into the dangerous forest by her wicked stepmother, a princess is rescued by seven dwarf miners who make her part of their household.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1940 · Pinocchio
metas.description: A living puppet, with the help of a cricket as his conscience, must prove himself worthy to become a real boy.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1942 · Bambi
metas.description: The story of a young deer growing up in the forest.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1941 · Dumbo
metas.description: Ridiculed because of his enormous ears, a young circus elephant is assisted by a mouse to achieve his full potential.
